scope: Tariff campaign selection, costly pilot exploration, net ARPU and constrained portfolio allocation. This is a curated research snapshot, not an automatic web search or an exhaustive literature review.

papers.title: Budget-Constrained Causal Bandits: Bridging Uplift Modeling and Sequential Decision-Making
papers.finding: Combines online effect learning, exploration and budget pacing when historical data is scarce.
papers.application_proposal: Choose the next pilot by expected usefulness for the final budget-constrained campaign plan.
papers.limitation: Advertising study; its individual sequential treatment setting differs from this case's batched pilots and ten filter-defined campaigns. Reported performance does not transfer to Beeline.

papers.title: Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning
papers.finding: ReAlloc addresses fixed-budget allocation across channels, confounding, extrapolation and cross-channel substitution.
papers.application_proposal: Compare channel options jointly under the remaining budget rather than choosing a channel solely by its effectiveness multiplier.
papers.limitation: Continuous multi-channel allocation on an e-commerce platform is not the same action space as four discrete telecom channels.

papers.title: Evaluating Uplift Modeling under Structural Biases: Insights into Metric Stability and Model Robustness
papers.status: arXiv record states accepted by KDD 2026
papers.finding: Studies how data biases affect uplift estimates and evaluation; good prediction and good targeting need not coincide.
papers.application_proposal: Evaluate actual net campaign value over several seeds and avoid treating historical before/after changes as identified causal effects.
papers.limitation: History here has no explicit untreated comparison group or channel field; a causal estimator cannot repair missing experimental identification by itself.

papers.title: Turning Re-Loyalty Scores into Action: A Mixed-Integer Optimization Framework for Broadband Offers in B2B Telecom
papers.finding: Combines LightGBM renewal scores with mixed-integer optimization to select broadband offers under business constraints.
papers.application_proposal: Use an explicit allocation solver for budget, contact count, campaign count and segment exclusivity.
papers.limitation: B2B broadband renewal offers and prediction scores differ from this synthetic tariff-switching experiment. Publisher search-index abstract was available; direct page retrieval returned 403.

papers.title: Bi-Level Decision-Focused Causal Learning for Large-Scale Marketing Optimization: Bridging Observational and Experimental Data
papers.finding: Uses experimental evidence to guide decision-focused learning from biased observational data.
papers.application_proposal: Build weak historical priors and update them with current-audience pilots; judge usefulness by final portfolio value.
papers.limitation: Its full bi-level training method is a development direction, not required to implement a nine-hour MVP.

github.role: Constrained campaign allocation; MVP can use greedy selection first.
github.limitation: Requires an explicit model of overlap and contact costs; is not a turnkey Beeline agent.
Budget, contact caps, pilot batches and revenue-valued rewards still need case-specific handling.

github.role: Uplift estimation and multi-treatment methods for later expansion.
github.limitation: Use estimators for continuous revenue outcomes and only with appropriate treatment/control data and assumptions.

github.role: Heterogeneous treatment effects and policy learning for later expansion.
github.limitation: Historical before/after observations alone do not identify causal effects.
